packageRules.description: Database majors need a manual dump/restore or pg_upgrade; an in-place tag bump breaks the data directory (see the reverted immich Postgres 14->16 bump).
Meilisearch refuses to start on a database from a different minor version without a dump/migration.

nfs-gateway's rclone binary is copied from rclone/rclone's own image and is CGO-linked against its build glibc/libfuse - confirmed to segfault immediately (even on --version) when run on debian:13-slim. Pinned to a digest instead of just the floating 12-slim tag so Renovate still proposes real Debian 12 point-release/security rebuilds; only the major jump to 13 is blocked.

Automerge minor, patch and digest updates once they are 2 days old, during the day. Renovate waits for the validate check to pass; majors and 0.x versions stay manual. Exclusions below switch automerge off again for anything stateful or CRD-heavy.
0.x versions: minor bumps can be breaking, keep them manual (patch/digest still automerge).
Never automerge Ceph/Rook: storage changes need Sander's explicit approval.
Never automerge Ceph/Rook images or charts wherever they appear.
Never automerge databases and their operators: upgrades can touch on-disk data.
Never automerge database apps by path (catches the CNPG 'cluster' chart and anything else in them).
Never automerge CRD-heavy operators and cluster plumbing: chart minors often change CRDs or admission webhooks.
Python minor releases (3.14 -> 3.15) behave like majors for the scripts that use them.
Tekton operator images are released together; one PR instead of one per image.
